I have been farming in Tabora for many years, and on this rented plot I grow tobacco because it gives me cash to pay the rent and buy necessities for my household. I will get some fertilizer and chemicals through the tobacco buyers who give us inputs on credit, but I can only manage a modest amount because the debt is deducted from our sales. My family will do most of the work with hand hoes since we cannot afford machines, though I will hire a few young men from the village to help during the busiest weeks of planting and harvesting.
